free_tier.stated: No total quota published; 2 GB maximum per file.

retention.stated: Inactive files deleted 30 days after last visit

tooling: No official API. Web upload requires login; community tools (bunkr-downloader / gallery-dl extractors) exist but are third-party and fragile.
chaining: Unlimited accounts x unlimited files at 2 GB each. 2 GB/file x N files is enough for bulk media; retention needs activity every 30 days.
limits_note: 2 GB per file (hard, on the landing page). Requires login to upload ('Running in private mode. Login to upload'). Inactive files deleted 30 days after last visit. Explicitly bans movies/TV shows.

identity_cost.detail: derived from the record's prose, not from an identity field, and no signup was executed: 30 days after last visit. Explicitly bans movies/TV shows. anonymous-dump

reliability_note: Small per-file cap and login-gated uploads make it poor for datasets; the 30-day activity rule plus a ban list that covers most large media means files disappear for reasons outside your control. Domain rotates (.cr/.ru/.su).
